# Young's Engineering Consultancy Ltd. (YEC)

> Civil and structural engineering firm based in Belize City, Belize, serving the country since 2000. YEC provides engineering design, feasibility studies, construction monitoring, and project management for infrastructure, commercial, residential, hospitality, water, and heritage projects across Belize.

## About

Young's Engineering Consultancy Ltd. (YEC) is a licensed Belizean engineering firm founded in 2000 and headquartered at 828 Coney Drive, Belize City. The firm is led by principal engineers with decades of experience in civil and structural engineering. YEC works across the public and private sectors, partnering with government agencies, international development banks, and private developers. The firm holds memberships with professional engineering bodies and has completed landmark projects including Belize's first internationally branded luxury hotel (the Alaia Marriott in San Pedro).

Contact: +501-223-2072 | info@yecbelize.com | 828 Coney Drive, Belize City, Belize

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.yecbelize.com/services): Full-service civil and structural engineering, feasibility studies, structural design, civil engineering (roads, drainage, utilities), water and wastewater systems, construction monitoring, project management, and cost estimation.

## Projects

- [Projects Index](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects): Portfolio of completed engineering projects across Belize, filterable by category.
- [Alaia Marriott Hotel](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/alia-marriott-hotel): Structural and civil engineering for Belize's first Marriott-branded luxury resort in San Pedro, Ambergris Caye.
- [MIRAB Complex](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/mirab): Civil and structural engineering for a multi-storey retail and office development in Belize City.
- [Belize River Valley Water Project](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/belize-river-valley-water-project): Water supply infrastructure serving communities across the Belize River Valley.
- [City Streets & Park Upgrade](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/city-streets-and-park-upgrade): Civic infrastructure upgrade including roads and Memorial Park in Fort Point, Belize City.
- [Archaeological Sites Upgrade](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/archaeological-sites-upgrade): Infrastructure improvements at Xunantunich, Cahal Pech, and ATM archaeological sites.
- [Elevated Water Storage Reservoirs](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/elevated-water-storage-reservoirs): Design of elevated water storage reservoirs in San Felipe, Douglas, and Sunday Wood villages.
- [Belize Municipal Development Project](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/belize-municipal-development-project): Infrastructure works across six municipalities in Belize.
- [Hatchet Caye Island Resort](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/hatchet-caye-island-resort): Engineering for a private island resort development at Hatchet Caye.
- [The Villas at Coco Plum](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/the-villas-at-coco-plum): Residential engineering for villa development on the Placencia Peninsula.
- [Solid Waste Landfill Access Road](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/solid-waste-landfill-access-road): Civil engineering for landfill access road at Mile 24, Belize.
- [Residential & Commercial Buildings](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/various-residential-commercial-buildings): Structural and civil engineering for various residential and commercial buildings nationwide.
- [Caye Caulker Wastewater Project](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/caye-caulker-wastewater-project): Full design of a vacuum-based wastewater collection network and modular treatment system for Caye Caulker Village, in partnership with Project Planning Management Limited and wastewater specialist Guillermo Madariaga.
- [San Pedro Million Gallon Storage Reservoir](https://www.yecbelize.com/projects/san-pedro-million-gallon-reservoir): Design and construction monitoring of a one million gallon concrete storage reservoir for Belize Water Services in San Pedro, featuring dual 500,000-gallon compartments and rooftop reverse osmosis, pump, and mechanical/electrical facilities.

## Team & Affiliates

- [Our Team](https://www.yecbelize.com/our-team): Principal engineers and staff at Young's Engineering Consultancy.
- [Our Affiliates](https://www.yecbelize.com/our-affiliates): Specialist affiliate engineers including structural, geotechnical, water/wastewater, and MEP experts who collaborate with YEC on projects requiring additional disciplines.
